messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — did a quick sweep of audit events for sprint planning. Found gaps across gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/... Can we triage today? cc @Aj Patel @Samir Gomez

Aj Patel: On it. Which gap is highest risk?

Maria Chen: Gateway: missing `route.override` and `api.key.create` events; Auth: missing `role.grant` and `token.revoked` with actor metadata; Console: missing `iam.console-login` with source IP; Billing: charge-adjustments lack request_id; Runtime: model-serve restart events only logged at INFO (no trace id).

Samir Gomez: Would like concrete schema snippets. Do we have standardized fields? e.g. event_type, actor_id, actor_role, request_id, ip, resource, outcome, trace_id

Maria Chen: Yes. Canonical minimal: {event_type, timestamp, actor_id, actor_email, actor_role, resource, action, outcome, request_id, trace_id, metadata}. Many svc only emit a subset.

Nora Li: Is KMS involved? Billing adjustments should reference KMS key id for PII masking.

DevOpsBot: audit-lint: gateway svc emitting deprecated schema v1.1 — please run migration tool

Aj Patel: Quick plan: 1) Triage per service; 2) Owners add tickets (SEC-AUDIT-XXX); 3) Target for sprint. Volunteers?

Leo Park: I can pick API gateway + migration fix. Will open ticket and include sample logs.

Samir Gomez: I'll do auth + console login events. Need help mapping RBAC changes — role.grant/role.revoke must include before/after role list.

Maria Chen: Priya, can you own billing adjustments? We need request_id and KMS-based masking.

Priya Kumar: Ack. Will open SEC-AUDIT-221 for billing. Need @security-ops for KMS key rotation check.

Nora Li: For runtime, attach trace_id from tracer; runtime team to ensure trace propagation and log level accuracy.

RuntimeBot: deploy-bot: created rollback watch for runtime restarts during triage window

Aj Patel: Action items: tickets + owners + ETA EOW. Add unit tests/assertions for required fields + example event in docs.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: I'll update audit-event-catalog sheet and share link. Please add PRs with unit/test harness.

Samir Gomez: Also: customer-facing audit event validation — need mapping doc for SOC2 customers. I'll draft.

Priya Kumar: Adding cross-check with billing ledger-export to ensure request ids match.

Maria Chen: Scheduling 30m triage at 10:30 PT. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/triage

Aj Patel: Closing loop: Leo, Samir, Priya, Nora owners noted. ETA Friday COB. I'll follow up here. :white_check_mark:
